chapter_title_en: The Humiliation of the Otherworld Ancestral God
chapter_seo_title: World of Immortality Ch. 607: An Ancestral God Humiliated, the Emperor's City Rises
chapter_meta_description: Sha Polang grotesquely humiliates an Otherworld Ancestral God. The Emperor's City shatters Meng Degang's incarnation. Three skeletons steal his stone limbs. Xiao Chen performs Sacred Sacrifice.
og_title: World of Immortality Chapter 607: Sha Polang's Torment and the Emperor's City Appears
og_description: Xiao Chen and Keke capture an Ancestral God; Sha Polang inflicts a degrading beating. Meanwhile, the Emperor's City rises in the Death World, destroying Meng Degang's incarnation. The three skeleton kings pull off a heist.
twitter_title: Ch. 607: Torment of a God, Rise of a City
twitter_description: Sha Polang's feet meet an Ancestral God's face. The Emperor's City crushes Meng Degang. Three skeletons steal stone limbs. Xiao Chen's Sacred Sacrifice continues.
